summary: The previous round's findings are resolved. What remains is two reusable facts about collinear four-vectors that the PR derives inline instead of stating once: the component of a collinear spatial part along the axis (4 sites) and the nullness of a collinear vector with |p| = E (2 sites, in two different modules).
